cohort: 100 patients admitted to the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at VIMSAR, Burla, India, who underwent hysterectomy between October 2015 and September 2017.
finding: NDVH was faster than TLH, while TLH allowed for easier oophorectomy if adnexal pathology was detected intraoperatively; TLH was associated with more ureteric injuries, but there were no other significant differences in complications, though patients undergoing TLH experienced less postoperative pain.
followup_time: The duration of hospital stay was recorded, but specific follow-up time beyond that is not mentioned.
